design_issues.screen: /kr2 (and any page rendering the KR selector)
issues: Hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — caused by Emergent DevTools instrumentation wrapping option text with '<span x-file-name>'; not authored by app code. Same warning already documented in iteration 31. Cosmetic dev-only, does not affect runtime UI.

critical_code_review_comments: qru.js StatusChip STATUS_MAP is case-sensitive on the raw status string; if any backend endpoint ever emits 'verified' (lowercase) or a new status like 'On Hold' it silently falls back to the slate/gray tone with no dev warning. Consider a dev-only console.warn in dev mode when a status falls back to 'slate'.

qru.js MetricCard renders as a <button> with disabled={!onClick}; disabled buttons cannot receive :hover styling on some browsers/assistive tech, and screen readers announce them as 'dimmed'. For non-clickable metric cards, using a <div role='group'> would preserve semantics and remove disabled-announcement noise.

qru.js Panel: when `title` is empty but `right` is provided, the header renders with only the right slot floating right — visually fine but the empty

still occupies flex space. Guard with `title && (...)`.

Layout.js NAV array is 60+ items in a single file (~200 lines). Consider extracting NAV to a data module (src/config/nav.js) — improves testability of route→testid mapping and keeps Layout.js focused on shell rendering.

Layout.js sidebar renders 60+ NavLink items unconditionally; even for non-Founder roles all nav links are shown. If role-based nav hiding is intended by a future MO, the current implementation does not gate by user.role.

ManufacturingInspection.js GateDetail modal shows a plain 'Inspecting…' loader (line 29) but has no timeout / retry — if `/inspection/product/{id}` hangs, the modal is stuck until user closes. Add an AbortController + 15s timeout with a retry button.

EvidenceDashboard.js: 15 metric-cards are wired to a drilldown modal; the drilldown-close button only closes on click — pressing Escape or clicking outside currently works via the overlay but there is no keyboard-focus trap. Minor a11y polish.

Connectors.js StageTimeline is passed `current={-1}` — meaning no active stage globally. The library treats -1 correctly (nothing active, nothing done) but the intent is fuzzy; either wire it to the currently-focused connector's stage or drop the numeric current and just show the labeled steps.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 7 flagship pages render, all sampled testids resolve, all critical interactions (login, nav, metric-card click, modal open/close, filter toggle, section expand, dev-mode toggle) succeed
